properties.headline: Flash Flood Warning issued September 16 at 6:40AM MDT until September 16 at 9:30AM MDT by NWS Albuquerque NM
properties.description:
At 640 AM MDT, emergency management reported flash flooding in
Ruidoso area, including areas downstream of the Salt burn scar. Up to
2 inches of rain have fallen. The expected rainfall rate is 2 inches
in 1 hour. Additional rainfall amounts up to 1 inch are possible in
the warned area. Flash flooding is already occurring.

HAZARD...Life threatening flash flooding. Heavy rain producing flash
flooding.

SOURCE...Emergency management reported flash flooding in the Ruidoso
area, including along Cree Meadows Drive, White Mountain
Drive, and along Cedar Creek and Fence Canyon.

IMPACT...Life threatening flash flooding of creeks and streams, urban
areas, highways, streets and underpasses.

Some locations that will experience flash flooding include...
Ruidoso, Ruidoso Downs and Hollywood.
properties.instruction:
Turn around, don't drown when encountering flooded roads. Most flood
deaths occur in vehicles.

Be aware of your surroundings and do not drive on flooded roads.

NWSheadline: FLASH FLOOD WARNING REMAINS IN EFFECT UNTIL 930 AM MDT THIS MORNING FOR SOUTH CENTRAL LINCOLN COUNTY
CMAMtext: NWS: FLASH FLOOD WARNING this area til 9:30 AM MDT. Avoid flooded areas.
CMAMlongtext: National Weather Service: A FLASH FLOOD WARNING is in effect for this area until 9:30 AM MDT. This is a dangerous and life-threatening situation. Do not attempt to travel unless you are fleeing an area subject to flooding or under an evacuation order.

properties.headline: Special Marine Warning issued September 16 at 8:19AM EDT until September 16 at 9:15AM EDT by NWS Melbourne FL
properties.description:
SMWMLB

The National Weather Service in Melbourne has issued a

* Special Marine Warning for...
Volusia-Brevard County Line to Sebastian Inlet 0-20 nm...

* Until 915 AM EDT.

* At 818 AM EDT, a strong thunderstorm was located 10 nm east of
Patrick Space Force Base, moving west at 25 knots.

HAZARD...Wind gusts 34 knots or greater.

SOURCE...Radar.

IMPACT...Expect wind gusts in excess of 34 knots, suddenly higher
waves, lightning and heavy downpours. Make sure all on
board are wearing life jackets. Return to safe harbor if
possible.

* Locations impacted include...
Palm Shores, South Patrick Shores, Satellite Beach, Indian Harbour
Beach, and Patrick Space Force Base.
properties.instruction: Move to safe harbor until hazardous weather passes.
